note: Tradable universe for the forward desk. ONLY tickers listed here may be traded by any strategy; verify.py (V4) enforces this. Populated exclusively from verified GET /series and GET /markets responses committed under data/raw with provenance — never from memory or search results.
selection_criteria: active status at capture time with a two-sided displayed book (fill evidence must exist)
volume >= 1,000 contracts or displayed liquidity >= $100 (tradeable, not a ghost)
settlement source named in rules_primary (so settlements are independently checkable)
spread from at least one of the competition's target families (macro, commodity/crypto direction, game, weather) so the cross-market DB can compare series
